run_cli_print_inventory: run the sphinx.py CLI to pretty print a Sphinx inventory file to stdout
run_cli_list_types: run the sphinx.py CLI with --types to list all type keys in an inventory file
run_cli_repack_inventory: run the sphinx.py CLI with --repack to recompress a raw inventory file back to binary
parse_intersphinx_inventory: parse a Sphinx inventory v2 file and populate a Python dict with cross-reference entries
consume_docstring: consume a Python docstring and parse it into m.css Sphinx-compatible RST directive output
